mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT ON (dl.driver_id) dl.driver_id AS driverId, d.full_name AS driverName, dl.latitude, dl.longitude, dl.recorded_at AS recordedAt, dl.received_at AS receivedAt FROM driver_locations dl JOIN drivers d ON d.id = dl.driver_id WHERE d.active = TRUE ORDER BY dl.driver_id, dl.received_at DESC
